leadText: David Kaye (born, David V. Hope; October 14, 1964) is a Canadian voice actor. He is best known for his work animation and gaming, notably remembered for voicing Sesshomaru in , in the video game series, various characters in several animated shows based on the and franchises, and the announcer of on . In the Pokémon franchise, he voices Gibeon in the English-language dub of .
plainText:
David Kaye (born, David V. Hope; October 14, 1964) is a Canadian voice actor. He is best known for his work animation and gaming, notably remembered for voicing Sesshomaru in , in the video game series, various characters in several animated shows based on the and franchises, and the announcer of on . In the Pokémon franchise, he voices Gibeon in the English-language dub of .
